random.formula: floor(2^128 * ln((v+1)/v)), v=1..1000 (precisions 100 and 130 must agree)

values_file.content: 36 series x 30 opportunities [value, counter]; every counter is 0

sweep_matched.order: sort by SHA-256 of b5-generator-contrast-v1|sweep|<w>|<r>|<v>, then v

llm.configuration: knowledge-bearing K2 manual loop (planner-v4 / coder-v4-autonomous-k2 / critic, reflux on, D2155 critic diagnosis), one fresh parent session per series (D2216)

parent_settings.note: alias-to-model mapping variable, not a credential

llm.generation_parameters: temperature, top_p, max tokens and similar sampling parameters have no specification interface in the client and are not observable; they are recorded as client defaults, not as fixed values
llm.model_recording: tools/b5_llm_round.py record-models per role call: all assistant message.model values, client versions, agentType, toolUseId, raw sha256 of transcript and meta; matches_expected is recorded, not enforced by the tool
llm.mismatch_rule: If any role record has matches_expected false, the parent publishes neither the proposal nor a rejection for the current opportunity and closes the session; the series ends by proposal-wait-timeout (unclassified missing), no rescue or re-draw. Critics run only before the next opportunity (for the evaluation whose diagnosis feeds it), never after the final evaluation, so every critic mismatch also ends the series this way
llm.critic_timing: When request-<a> has next_evaluation k >= 2 and critic-<k-1> does not exist yet, run the critic for evaluation k-1 before inputs --a <a>; A-only rejections (no new evaluation) run no critic; no critic after the final evaluation
llm.a_only_rejections: Empty or invalid planner/coder output and failed proposal checks are rejected with reject --a <a> (A consumed) without editing or re-asking; child-side preprocess or Tier0 rejection publishes no slot and the next request keeps the same k
llm.prompts: Templates live in tools/b5_llm_round.py (sha256 in files_sha256). Generated prompts do not exist before the run (they embed each series' start-stock value); the tool prints and stores each generated prompt's sha256 under the materials root
llm.input_schema: planner input {current_perf, leading_indicators {cache_miss_rate_pct, contention_level, IPC_overall}, whiteboard (exactly k-1 entries), knowledge_input, k2_critic_diagnosis (k >= 2 only, 6 fields)}; coder input {leakproof_context, knowledge_input, baseline, planner_direction, whiteboard, k2_critic_diagnosis (k >= 2)}
llm.initial_input: k = 1: current_perf and baseline = series-start stock of the same job; empty whiteboard; no diagnosis key
llm.missing_values: null and the text 'null (欠測)'; never 0
llm.retained_pilot_constraint: coder is asked for an integer literal (narrower than the accepted grammar); kept as a pilot configuration fact
prompt_changes_from_pilot: labels: pilot (T-2797, write-heavy series 1) -> registered cohort, workload and series from the ledger header
series-start stock described as measured sequentially at the start of the same job, not a contemporaneous control
coder: 'B-5 pilot' operating point and verification wording -> 'B-5 main run'
critic: every missing metric (fitness, anomalies, median, rep count, rep list, CV, rounds, settled, abort rate, LLC miss rate, IPC) is printed as 'null (欠測)' instead of 0 or None
absolute paths replaced by arguments; knowledge projection reference moved to the repository copy of the T-2746 knowledge-input.json

schedule.design: reverse-order pairs A={LRS,SRL} B={LSR,RSL} C={RLS,SLR}; excluded pair e=(w+b-1) mod 3; block b holds series 4(b-1)+1..4b; stage s runs position s; block-stock (series=block) in stage 2
schedule.properties_checked_by_parent: 36 order rows, 117 jobs (36 per arm + 9 stock), jobs per (block, stage) 12/15/12, LLM jobs per (block, stage) = 4, each workload uses each of 6 orders twice, LLM before/after each baseline 2/2 per (workload, block)
schedule.procedure: next stage only after every job of the previous stage ended; next block at least 1 h after the previous block's last job ended; recorded from job and ledger timestamps, no runtime check

walltime.formula: W = ceil(21259 s x k) for series jobs of all three search arms; W_stock = ceil(5447 s x k) for block-stock jobs (D2217); 0 < k <= 4.06

total_wall.counted: sum of job Elapse including parent waits (preregistration section 11, D2200 item 1 (3))

rep1_warmup_check: No session-definition change: max |median(2..5)/median(1..5)-1| = 0.6960% over 53 pilot sessions, 0 at or above 1%, 0 CV-gate changes (insight rep 1 section)
n1_duplicate_skip: No code change; reachable only by re-running a slot in the same submit-tree or importing a campaign; if the first attempt of a slot is skipped after submission, B is under-recorded by 1, the report does not flag it and the series becomes score-missing; a skip on a retry attempt keeps B through submitted_once (insight N1 section)
